net2.http.logged_out: you're logged out, log in again (ctrl-l)
net2.http.slow_bit: slow down, try again in a bit
net2.http.trouble: heatsync is having trouble, try again soon
net2.http.slow_minute: slow down, try again in a minute
net2.http.link_first: link that account on heatsync.org first
net2.http.bad_input: that didn't look right, check it and try again
net2.emote.swapped: your {name} is now the one you picked
net2.emote.kept_upload: kept your own upload as {name}: an upload never gets swapped out
net2.emote.swap_failed: couldn't swap {name}, you still have your old one: {why}
net2.mrules.auth: log in to heatsync.org to keep mention rules
net2.mrules.limited: slow down a little, then try again
net2.inv.applied_n: set applied: {n} emotes (your old ones are in removed)
net2.inv.applied: set applied (your old ones are in removed)
net2.mutes.mute_failed: couldn't save your mute of {name} on heatsync: {why}
net2.mutes.unmute_failed: couldn't save your unmute of {name} on heatsync: {why}, it may come back at your next login
net2.recent.missed: couldn't fetch what you missed in {channel}
net2.upload.kinds: that isn't a picture or video heatsync takes (png jpg gif webp avif bmp tiff mp4 webm mov)
net2.upload.apng: animated png isn't supported, turn it into a gif or webp first
net2.upload.bad_link: heatsync sent back a link i don't trust
net2.upload.reply_big: heatsync sent a reply that's too big
net2.upload.not_emote: an emote has to be a png, gif, webp, jpg or avif picture
net2.emote.bad_name: a name is one word: no spaces, and it can't start with / or .
net2.emote.name_taken: you already have an emote with that name, pick another
net2.emote.set_full: your emote set is full, remove one first
net2.update.no_build: there is no download for this computer yet
net2.update.no_exe: can't find where this app is installed
net2.update.unsigned: the download isn't signed by heatsync: not installed
net2.update.download_failed: the download didn't work, try again later
net2.update.replace_failed: couldn't put the new version in place, nothing was changed
